name: Nurse independent prescriber
cd_note: Any Schedule 2, 3, 4 or 5 controlled drug, except cocaine, diamorphine or dipipanone for treating addiction (reg 6B(2)).
scope_note: Any medicine for any condition within own competence.

name: Pharmacist independent prescriber
cd_note: Any Schedule 2, 3, 4 or 5 controlled drug, except cocaine, diamorphine or dipipanone for treating addiction (reg 6B(2)).
scope_note: Any medicine for any condition within own competence.

name: Paramedic independent prescriber
cd_note: Only the named controlled drugs by the specified route, for the treatment of organic disease or injury.
scope_note: Any licensed medicine for any condition within own competence. Off-label permitted; unlicensed not permitted.

name: Physiotherapist independent prescriber
cd_note: Only the named controlled drugs by the specified route, for the treatment of organic disease or injury.
scope_note: Any licensed medicine within own competence, within the framework of human movement, performance and function. Off-label permitted; unlicensed not permitted.

name: Podiatrist (chiropodist) independent prescriber
cd_note: Only the named controlled drugs by the specified route, for the treatment of organic disease or injury.
scope_note: Any licensed medicine within own competence, for disorders of the foot, ankle and associated structures. Off-label permitted; unlicensed not permitted.

name: Therapeutic radiographer independent prescriber
cd_note: Only the named controlled drugs by the specified route, for the treatment of organic disease or injury.
scope_note: Any licensed medicine within own competence, within the framework of cancer treatment. Off-label only under specific conditions; unlicensed not permitted.

name: Supplementary prescriber (any eligible profession)
cd_note: Any Schedule 2, 3, 4 or 5 controlled drug included in the patient's clinical management plan, except cocaine, diamorphine or dipipanone for treating addiction.
scope_note: Any medicine included in the patient's clinical management plan agreed with the doctor and patient.
source: CPE who-can-prescribe-what (statutory reference to be added)
